576.text: PNG RGBA straight alpha, transparent outside = 0, RGB zeroed for fully transparent pixels; natural fractional edge alpha retained. Ninja: 576×576, origin [288,376], 2 texture px per old Canvas unit. Files retain existing integration names under color/action folders; this explicit compatibility exception supersedes the generic template name format. Sheets use three columns for cycles, two for death. No baked paper or checkerboard. One source rig; mirrored at rendering time. Suggested playback air6/patrol8/throw12 FPS; actual AI timing unchanged. Runtime can downsample ninjas to 288 px for mobile; exported originals remain full size. Expanded PNG memory estimate must be measured, not assumed. Assets may not introduce gameplay dependencies. Default camera supports portrait 390×844 and wider desktop.

Export per-half alpha outline coordinates for contact computation.

G+23.text: G=H−max(116,102+safeBottom())；原safeBottom=0。hero站立逻辑y=G；ninja站立逻辑y=G−12；corpse接触面G+23。旧背景地面线也是G+23。因此只加一条精确背景线应以G+23为基准，但人物站立脚会有旧有的视觉偏差。可使用极窄地面墨带或纯渲染地面人物脚底校正；不要移动G、hero.y、n.y及碰撞中心。
主目标 390×844；兼顾 320×568、375×812、430×932 与桌面。保留原 v33 触控区底边 G 与所有模拟参数。因真实尸体接地线为 G+23，新的下方纸幅固定90px高，从 G+26 开始，接地线前后3px保持可见，避免画面看似尸体悬空。安全区较大的实机仍需浏览器走查，不能因此暗改 G 或物理。

frozen.text: Hero keeps frozen long brows, beard and billowing robe. Ninjas use a compact hood and irregular continuous ink mass; joints dissolve into connected sleeve/pant strokes. Airborne knees fold close to the waist. Avoid rectangles, regular circles, polygonal elbows, neat V-neck and shoe blocks. Eyes are small outer-high/inner-low triangular reserves. Environments are incomplete organic strokes. UI combines vertical inscription rhythm with simple readable numbers and small seals.

Only project sources: (1) original_source.png supplies natural ink edges and density; (2) frozen v05 flight supplies silhouette readability/white brow reserves; (3) moon_v01 supplies concentration of pigment versus pale force. These are complementary views of the same approved visual identity. No external style graft. Avoid perfectly outlined costumes, geometric ragdoll-looking anatomy, airbrushed gradients, bright energy loops, decorative particle clouds. Do not trace old Canvas rectangles and call them final brush art.

冻结.text: 批准依据：用户本轮明确冻结既有玩法与主角动作；美术升级按无人值守授权执行，新增美术仍待最终人工观感确认。

允许：新忍者、美术动画、剑光局部寿命、速度线、背景、UI、资源装载、测试入口。冻结：v33 的 resize/reset/performJump/jump/pressZone/startUltimate/spawnNinja/fireNinjaShot/scheduleAttack/kill/hitNinja/swordHit/corpseBottomOffset/update 及其关键常量。已通过 v05 上下落与 moon_v01 持剑文件逐字节复用；stage2 站立也保留。新增文件写新独立目录，不覆盖稳定版。

tail.text: At least approximately 80% open warm white. Two or three faint mountain gestures on one side, no detailed scenery. Ground is one horizontal variable-density stroke placed at the real collision height; minor dry brush below it supplies thickness. No temples, pine forests, railings, patterned tiles or busy paper stains.

Art Bible anchors: §3 irregular organic mass; §4 muted pigment variants; §5 compact combat silhouette; §8 exact formats/anchors. Recommended generation prompt is persisted in qa/art/production-log.json and work/studio_v1/art/ninja-prompt.txt before execution. Use original elder as actual image input. Negative constraints: no paper background, no blue glow, no geometric joints, no vector outlines, no muscle detail, no neck V, no weapons or decor.

Owned by VFX integration pass. Real source brush imagery, time-resolved local reveal and tail-first dry erosion. Preserve radius, angle, collision and duration. Require actual normal and slow playback. Do not animate the whole raster with only a global alpha.
Owned by VFX integration pass. Two/three short directional real-brush strokes during ascent and gentler fall airflow. Follow world velocity, preserve readability, no long black tail.
